Title: Power BI Embedded capacity metrics to monitor workloads

Body.Content:
To ensure proactive management of workloads, two new metrics allow monitoring (and alerting) per workload:

  • Memory Per Workload presents the usage of memory in your capacity resource per workload.
  • QPU Per Workload presents the query processing unit (QPU) load on your capacity, per workload. A QPU is a unit of measure of relative computational performance for query and data processing. One core approximates to 20 QPUs. With an A1, for example, you have values between 0 and 20 QPUs, where 20 represents 100% load.

For more information, see the Power BI blog post.
